"Grim Monolith Purification Trials":
"In Grim Monolith Purification Trials, your objective is to purify a Grim Monolith that has been corrupted by enemies.

Defeating nearby enemies will purify a Grim Monolith, and the Trial is cleared when all Grim Monoliths have been purified."
"A purified Grim Monolith grants all nearby players increased attack power and damage reduction for a short time."
